newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia steps up probe of possible aluminium crime.
newsitem.headline: Russia steps up probe of possible aluminium crime.

text.p: Russia's Prosecutor General's office has stepped up the pace of an investigation into possible crime in the Russian aluminium industry, Interfax news agency quoted the office's information centre as saying on Friday.

"The pace of the investigation was discussed at a special operative conference at the Prosecutor General's office," Interfax said, adding the probe had originated at the Interior Ministry. "Concrete written instructions aimed at activating the investigation were given on this matter," it said.
Interfax quoted the Prosecutor General's office as saying it had the investigation under its full control.
